name: Venomancer: Chrysalis is in the Vizier tab (#11936)
contract: Issue #11936. Chrysalis (808082) is the Vizier talent CharacterAdvancement 6324 in Tab 92 and had no
SkillLineAbility row, so no spellbook tab listed it. The active Vizier talents, such as Blight Antidote (520153,
row 23469), are in SkillLine 499. Row 844, a duplicate of row 12780 (Feign Death 5384) that differs only in
MinSkillLineRank, is repurposed for 808082 at SkillLine 499, and the client patch streams that row after the
spell is learned. Feign Death keeps SkillLine 50 through its twin rows.

steps.label: CONTROL: Blight Antidote is in the Vizier line
CONTROL: row 844's old spell keeps its line through the twin rows
the row follows the learn announcement
the client patch carries SkillLine 499 for Chrysalis
